reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first access and the upgradingId parameter the link functions already take; there was no existing duplicate-link check to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule lives in one helper, assertNotLinkedElsewhere; only the call plus a provider string literal is repeated per link function.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link functions it protects, consistent with where those functions check upgradingId.

scope.why: Only the guard, its calls and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: The guard is wired into only three of the five provider link functions (Akahu and Enable Banking are left without it), so the rule silently depends on each new link function remembering to call it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; the issue is incomplete application of the new helper.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the check is defined once.

one_place.where: The rule is defined once in assertNotLinkedElsewhere, but linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount do not call it, so not every linking path applies it.
